title: A Phase 1 Clinical Study to Evaluate the Effects of SHR7280 on the Pharmacokinetics of Midazolam, S-warfarin, Omeprazole, Digoxin, and Rosuvastatin in Healthy Subjects

sections.abstract: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the effects of SHR7280 on the pharmacokinetics of midazolam, S-warfarin, omeprazole, digoxin and rosuvastatin in healthy subjects.
